Wikisource.fact: An initial wave of 14 languages was set up on August 23, 2005. On September 11, 2005, the wikisource.org wiki was reconfigured to enable the English version, along with 8 other languages that were created early that morning and late the night before.

Wikisource.subject: Indian Wildlife & National Parks
Wikisource.question: Three more languages were created on March 29, _____, and then another large wave of 14 language domains was created on June 2, 2006
Wikisource.fact: Three more languages were created on March 29, 2006, and then another large wave of 14 language domains was created on June 2, 2006.
